videoDetails.title: The Founding Vision of the PCA: Derek Radney and Sean Michael Lucas
videoDetails.shortDescription:
In a time of growing polarization within the PCA, questions about our identity have taken on new urgency. In this conversation with Derek Radney, historian and pastor Sean Michael Lucas revisits the denomination’s founding vision and considers how a clearer grasp of our history can inform the church’s life today.

Together, they explore competing narratives about the PCA’s origins, examine key moments and debates from its early years, and reflect on what the historical record reveals about who the PCA has been from the beginning. As Radney guides the conversation, they consider how historical clarity might help the church navigate disagreement with greater faithfulness, patience, and purpose.
